rules.statement: An agreement by a borrower to pay money and allow the lender to possess land in lieu of interest, even if non-notarial, can be used to prove an action to recover money and prevent prescription from running.
rules.supporting_quote: In an. action to recover money lent, an agreement by the borrower to pay the money and to allow the lender to possess a land in lieu of interest may be proved in order to prevent the running of prescription, although the agreement is non-notarial, Nagamuthu v. Sittambarampillai (33 N. L. R. 151), followed.
